subject.title: fix(mac): stop keychain prompt storms from gateway profile reads

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally isolate existing DEBUG Keychain profile and onboarding-binding state into new `.debug` services, with the documented recovery through the primary-connection migration?
rationale: This changes how existing developer builds discover persistent credentials and connection state; correctness of the cache does not decide whether that upgrade behavior is the desired supported developer experience.

options.title: Require device proof before merge
options.body: Capture a redacted macOS run showing the cached registry avoids repeated prompts and an existing DEBUG setup recovers the primary connection after namespace isolation.

options.title: Accept isolated DEBUG state
options.body: Approve the intentional DEBUG-only state reset based on the documented migration contract without additional upgrade evidence.

recommendation.title: Require device proof before merge
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted macOS run showing the cached registry avoids repeated prompts and an existing DEBUG setup recovers the primary connection after namespace isolation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context ties steipete directly to the proposed macOS Keychain ownership boundary and its stated DEBUG-build tradeoff.
